text:
jamie: FYI from support customer says they were billed twice when a streaming call hit a tool mid-stream and then the client reconnected. looks like both the toolcall and the resumed stream were billed for overlapping tokens

olivia: any traces/route info? :thinking:

jamie: trace ids 0xabc123 / 0xdef456, route=mux-eu, session=cli-4321. ledger shows a confirmed toolcall row then later a confirmed stream row that overlaps offsets

sandeep: paste the ledger excerpt? sounds like dedupe key not preserved across handoff

jamie: pasted snippet:
```
ledger: {ts:1670000123, session:"cli-4321", kind:"toolcall", tokens:34, tool_id:"search-v1", charge_state:"confirmed"}
ledger: {ts:1670000134, session:"cli-4321", kind:"stream", tokens:12, offset_start:120, charge_state:"provisional"}
ledger: {ts:1670000140, session:"cli-4321", kind:"stream", tokens:22, offset_start:132, charge_state:"confirmed"}
```
jamie: root cause seems to be that the resumed connection was routed to a different backend by the mux overlay. our dedupe is backend-local (toolcall_id+session) so the resumed backend had no knowledge of the earlier toolcall row

maria: so cross-backend dedupe gap. we intentionally allow mux to change backend for perf, but that breaks ledger dedupe when toolcalls finalize after a handoff

olivia: quick mitigation idea: console should surface "overlap suspected" when a provisional/confirmed stream token range intersects a toolcall range for the same session. give ops an "apply rollback" action to credit back tokens for the customer

sandeep: infra fix: propagate a lightweight global idempotency key at router handshake that follows the session across backend handoffs. ledger writes do a dedupe lookup by (global_key, token_range) before writing confirmed rows

jamie: watchouts: index cardinality and retention. storing global ids forever is not ok. propose TTL aligned to session keepalive (e.g., 5 minutes) and tombstone entries for toolcalls that linger 90s after tool response

maria: UX/obs ask: need a dashboard tile that counts "token-range overlap" events by route, backend, and customer tier. right now metrics are token counts and error rates only

olivia: also add a small canary flag to the mux rollout so we can disable cross-backend handoffs for sessions that have in-flight toolcalls until dedupe is implemented

sandeep: long-term checklist:
- router: attach global_session_key on handshake (low-cardinality)
- ledger: dedupe check by (global_session_key, offset_span) at confirm time
- tombstone index: configurable TTL per customer tier to avoid lost anchors
- console: overlap alerting + rollback action linked to raw ledger slice and trace

billing-bot: note: 1 customer impacted, ~68 tokens double-billed (provisional conflict). created ticket INC-4392.

jamie: i'll add traces to the ticket and gather a handful more examples. mari to prototype the dashboard query and quick rollback UX, sandeep to spike global key proof-of-concept, olivia to add mux canary toggle

maria: will attach a sample dashboard query and mockup. linking to the trace will let support fast-track refunds

jamie: thanks all. keep updates here before next sync. :pray:
